title: A request through CloudFront
claim: A request goes to the nearest edge location, and a cache miss travels on through the regional edge cache to the origin.
alt: A sequence with four participants: a viewer, an edge location, a regional edge cache and the origin. The viewer's request reaches the edge location, which has no copy. The edge location asks the regional edge cache, which also has no copy, and that cache asks the origin. The object travels back through both caches to the viewer, and both caches keep a copy.

messages.label: Request
messages.say: DNS routes the request to the edge location that can best serve it, typically the nearest one.

messages.label: Check cache
messages.say: The edge location checks its cache and returns the object when it has a copy.

messages.label: Miss
messages.say: On a miss, the request typically goes to the regional edge cache, which has a larger cache.

messages.label: Miss
messages.say: On a second miss, CloudFront forwards the request to the origin.

messages.label: Object
messages.say: As soon as the first byte arrives, CloudFront forwards it to the viewer and adds the object to the cache.
